snippet.title: Shake It Co! - Co-op Trailer
snippet.description:
Shake it Co! is a cozy 2D orchard game launching on Steam on August 19, 2026.
Shake trees to make fruit tumble to the ground, collect your harvest, and sell it for coins. Spend your earnings on upgrades, skills, and helpful NPCs as you turn a small patch of land into a thriving orchard.
Play solo or grow your orchard with friends in online Steam co-op.

Developed and published by Zero Task.

#indiegame #cozygame #incrementalgame #cozygaming #steamgame
